cases.expected: Tab from unfocused Settings -> Close dialog; Shift+Tab wraps to More settings

cases.actual: Coordinate square now toggles Snap off, row toggles it back on. As in baseline, focus retires after command and Space has no effect.

cases.reason: Standard picking/focus replaces the prior native gesture adapter.
cases.actual: Native keyboard shortcuts remove and restore Body1/Extrude1; history count returns to two.

cases.actual: Native save, Open chooser and reopen retain two profiles, Merge and 12 mm. Saved schema-15 model equals the baseline payload exactly.

cases.actual: Coordinate context-menu Edit feature; Flip square changes preview; coordinate Cancel restores original body. Save afterward preserves exact model payload.

retained_passes.resolved_automation_issue: Restarted the isolated empty Default V2 app through its File menu; coordinate pointer input now works. User confirmed unlocked/foreground; no lock diagnosis.
retained_passes.layout_repair: Bevy GhostNode groups Tab navigation without removing roots from the UI layout pass.

queued_findings.status: fixed in publication c625d5f9; seven source widget tests passed on fadb10eb
queued_findings.cause: widget partition runs before native capture/model-drag guard, so motion/release over a widget can be consumed before the existing owner releases

layout_repair_result.actual: Labels and icons render again; native coordinate File click opens the menu once. Real layout regression passes with a primary window.

settings_toggle.actual: Native pointer click sets selected=false; focused Space sets selected=true.

visual_comparison.result: Comparable controls; raw pixel deltas retained. Different camera zoom/position before Fit; System vs explicit Light selection; build hash, fixture labels, focus, browser expansion and checkbox glyph differences. Reopened feature dialog differs by 62 pixels in its region. Preview captures differ in distance (baseline 10 mm, rework 12 mm) and focused control; they compare layout only.

tab_repair.status: strict Clippy passed; source tests and build running
tab_repair.approach: Call standard Bevy TabNavigation with per-event native Shift modifier; no custom traversal algorithm.

retained_passes.record_note: Historical V4 checkpoint; failed/partial results below are preserved. See final_cases and final_rechecks for their V6 disposition. Relative evidence paths in this checkpoint start at v4/.

final_rechecks.expected: Tab from unfocused Settings reaches Close dialog; Shift+Tab wraps backward to More settings.
final_rechecks.actual: Tab reached Close dialog and Shift+Tab reached More settings. File also opened with Tab then Space.
final_rechecks.polish: No clipping, obscured state or layout regression observed in the exercised state.

final_rechecks.expected: Native field values remain editable; Tab and reverse Tab follow published visual order across native fields and Bevy checkboxes/buttons; Space activates once.
final_rechecks.actual: Distance changed from 12 to 14, Tab reached Taper then Flip, Space enabled Flip, and Shift+Tab reached the 14 mm canvas distance field in visual order. Tab returned to Flip then Cancel; Space canceled and restored the saved 12 mm, unflipped body.
final_rechecks.polish: No clipping, obscured state or layout regression observed in the exercised state.

final_rechecks.case: earlier sketch editing and release outside
final_rechecks.expected: Earlier-sketch editing hides later geometry. Releasing Finish Sketch outside its bounds does not finish; the next normal click finishes once and restores the body.
final_rechecks.actual: Native context-menu Edit sketch hid the extrusion. Dragging palette Finish Sketch to the canvas stayed in sketch mode. The next normal pointer click finished and restored Body1; native Save retained the exact baseline model.
final_rechecks.polish: No clipping, obscured state or layout regression observed in the exercised state.

final_rechecks.expected: A drag started on the canvas keeps ownership through release over a Bevy button; that release does not activate the button, and a subsequent normal click does.
final_rechecks.actual: Canvas drag released over File did not open its menu. The next coordinate File click opened it once; Escape closed it.
final_rechecks.polish: No clipping, obscured state or layout regression observed in the exercised state.

final_rechecks.expected: The native slider retains its drag through release over Close settings, without activating Close. Subsequent Reset and Close clicks work.
final_rechecks.actual: Dragging 3D mouse speed from 1.5 and releasing over Close changed it to 2.95 while Settings stayed open. Coordinate Reset restored 1.5; a normal Close click dismissed Settings and restored File focus.
final_rechecks.polish: No clipping, obscured state or layout regression observed in the exercised state.

fixes.issue: Window parent excluded UI roots from layout
fixes.resolution: Use standard Bevy GhostNode for focus group; live V4 layout and real-layout regression pass.

fixes.issue: Widget partition could consume an existing native drag release
fixes.resolution: Preserve native ownership before partition; final source tests and native canvas/slider drag checks passed.
Call Bevy TabNavigation with the native event modifier snapshot; strict Clippy, source regression and live reverse-Tab checks passed.
